name: Eiscafé Hohes Schloss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ice Cream Café Hohes Schloss in Füssen**

Welcome to **Eiscafé Hohes Schloss**, a charming ice cream café nestled in the heart of **Füssen**, right at the foot of **Schloss Hohenschwangau** and **Neuschwanstein Castle**. Here, you can indulge in creamy homemade ice cream, delicious **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh pastries, and much more.

Our cozy café offers a perfect break for visitors exploring the breathtaking **Tirol** and the fairy-tale castles of **Schwangau**. Enjoy your sweet treats while soaking in the stunning views of the **Alps** and the iconic **Neuschwanstein**.

Come by for a refreshing **Eis** or a hearty **Apfelstrudel**—every bite is a taste of **Tirol**’s finest!
